definitions.explanation: the branch of medicine dealing with children and their diseases
the department in a hospital that treats children

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小児科|しょうにか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I took my child to the pediatric clinic.

examples.japanese: {小児科|しょうにか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小児科|しょうにか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。

notes:
RELATED WORDS:
- {小児科|しょうにか}{医|い}: pediatrician
- ⟦{小児|しょうに}→小児：27025_shouni⟧: child (medical and official term)
- ⟦{乳幼児|にゅうようじ}→乳幼児：14882_nyuuyouji⟧: infants and toddlers

Other hospital departments: ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧ (internal medicine), ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧ (surgery), ⟦{整形外科|せいけいげか}→整形外科：22066_seikeigeka⟧ (orthopedics), ⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧ (dermatology), ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧ (ophthalmology), ⟦{耳鼻科|じびか}→耳鼻科：22874_jibika⟧ (ear, nose and throat), ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧ (dentistry), ⟦{産婦人科|さんふじんか}→産婦人科：16784_sanfujinka⟧ (obstetrics and gynecology).

USAGE:
Like other 〜{科|か} words, {小児科|しょうにか} names both the specialty and the clinic or department, so {小児科|しょうにか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ means going to a pediatrician's. Children in Japan usually see a {小児科|しょうにか} until about junior-high age.
